sleeves.name: LuckyDex Flagship
sleeves.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: LuckyDex exclusive collectible card sleeve art, a single flat 5:7 portrait card back, full bleed edge to edge.
Primary request: flagship premium red Pokédex sleeve. A substantial richly detailed red enamel Pokédex chassis forms the entire symmetrical outer frame, inset metallic edges, tiny buttons and red corner paneling. A brilliant circular blue glass lens and Poké Ball mechanical center is the dominant focal point, with charming recognizable Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle arranged as a lively triangular group around the lower lens. Small botanical and flame/water details layer behind them within the red device.
Style: premium richly rendered 16-bit pixel art inspired by Generation III/IV handheld Pokémon game art; deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, sophisticated shading, jewel highlights and dense but organized ornamental details. This is polished collectible game artwork, not a simple diagram.
Composition: strong recognizable thumbnail, intact decorative border, focal lens plus three characters, no blank regions. Every edge filled with finished art.
Constraints: flat sleeve artwork only, no photograph, no physical card mockup, no perspective rotation, no lettering, no watermark. Aspect ratio exactly 5:7 portrait.
